items.title: Gigante chinesa confirma 1º carro híbrido para o Brasil
items.pt:
A chinesa BAIC anunciou a expansão de sua estratégia no Brasil. A marca confirou dois novos utilitários esportivos pensados para quem roda fora de estrada: um é o híbrido B30, previsto para o segundo trimestre de 2027, e o outro é o grandalhão B60, já em processo de homologação no país.
Após estrear no mercado nacional com os modelos elétricos Arcfox T1 e Arcfox T5, a marca aposta em propulsão eletrificada robusta para disputar espaço no segmento off-road. Além disso, o avanço marca uma nova fas

items.title: LinkedIn Automation Tools vs AI Drafting Assistants
items.pt:
LinkedIn automation tools run actions for you at volume, such as sending connection requests and message sequences, while AI drafting assistants only help you write messages that you review and send yourself. The first optimizes for scale, the second for control and quality.

These are different categories, and they carry different risks. This guide compares the two approaches fairly, using Waalaxy, Dux-Soup and Expandi as automation examples and Letter Moth, which we build, as a drafting exampl

items.title: Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
items.pt: Scientific discovery often begins with an unexpected observation that prompts a new research question. In a world with altered physical laws, can large language models (LLMs) notice unexpected behavior, such as heavier objects falling more slowly, and discover the law through experiments without being told what to investigate? items.title: Scaling Laws for Tool-Use Agents via Controllable Environment Synthesis
items.pt: We explore how to build performant large language model (LLM) tool-use agents that complete complex, multi-step tasks. Specifically, we study how data composition in synthetically generated tool-use environments affects the training of such agents. items.title: Metacognitive Decoding: Efficient Inference for Diffusion Language Agents
items.pt: Diffusion language models offer a promising path to efficient agents through parallel token generation. However, efficient interaction requires adapting both where computation is spent and how much text is generated. We introduce a metacognitive controller that guides diffusion generation according to the needs of the current response and the agent's interaction with the environment. items.title: What Improves During Pretraining? Tracking Knowledge Acquisition with Point-in-Time Models
items.pt: Language models pretrained on web corpora collected over multiple years learn both general and domain-specific knowledge. How these different kinds of knowledge are learned as pretraining progresses remains unclear. Recent point-in-time models trained on web snapshots from different years provide a way to probe how knowledge prevalence varies over time. Using these models, we propose a temporal variability score (TVS), defined as the coefficient of variation of an item's negative log-likelihood
